findings.current: “Even though we’ve already lost our home?”
findings.defect: “Home” obscures that the sect has lost its headquarters.
findings.rationale: 본산 refers to the sect’s principal mountain or headquarters, not an ordinary home.
findings.replacement: “Even though we’ve already lost our sect’s headquarters?”

findings.current: The old man, who had called himself an empty-handed old man,
findings.defect: “Empty-handed” changes his self-deprecating joke from lacking substance to lacking possessions.
findings.rationale: 실속 없는 echoes his claim that the quoted speaker sounds impressive but has nothing of substance to offer.
findings.replacement: The old man, who had just called himself all talk and no substance,
findings.source: 스스로를 실속 없는 늙은이라 칭한 노인이

findings.current: The old man soared upward like a bird, then came sailing down from dozens of yards in the air. Exclamations rose from all around us.
findings.defect: The draft turns the distance he crosses through the air into his height above the ground and reduces dozens of jang to dozens of yards.
findings.rationale: 수십여 장의 허공을 가로질러 describes the span traversed; a jang is substantially longer than a yard.
findings.replacement: The old man soared like a bird, crossed dozens of jang through the air, and descended. Exclamations rose from all around us.
findings.source: 한 마리의 비조(飛鳥)처럼 높이 솟구친 노인의 신형이 자그마치 수십여 장의 허공을 가로질러 떨어져 내리는 광경에, 곳곳에서 탄성이 터져 나왔다.

findings.current: To a land far to the west, to the foot of a great mountain where the sky met the earth.
findings.defect: “The foot” replaces the great mountain slopes, and “where the sky met the earth” weakens the image of those slopes touching the sky.
findings.rationale: 거대한 산자락 is the vast mountain slopes; 그곳의 하늘과 맞닿은 describes them reaching the sky.
findings.replacement: To a land far to the west, to the vast slopes of a mountain that touched the sky.
findings.source: 머나먼 서쪽 너머의 땅, 그곳의 하늘과 맞닿은 거대한 산자락으로.

findings.current: They might each look middle-aged, elderly, and young, respectively,
findings.defect: The Bow Saint’s apparent age is raised from a mature adult to elderly.
findings.rationale: 장년 denotes mature adulthood, while 소년 specifically evokes a boy, contrasting their appearances with their accumulated years in Murim.
findings.replacement: They might look middle-aged, mature, and boyish, respectively,
findings.source: 제각각 중년, 장년, 소년의 모습을 하고 있지만

findings.current: During the Star-Array Grand Banquet, I’d spent some time with Gung Gibang and the others. One of them had been Hak Woo, the Kunlun Cloud Dragon—and Hak Woo was Cheongheoja’s Disciple.
findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung the person who spent time with Gung Gibang’s group; the source describes Hak Woo associating with them.
findings.rationale: 한동안 궁기방 등과 함께 어울려 다니던 modifies 학우, not the narrator.
findings.replacement: During the Star-Array Grand Banquet, Hak Woo, the Kunlun Cloud Dragon, had spent some time hanging around with Gung Gibang and the others. He was Cheongheoja’s Disciple.
findings.source: 성라대연이 한창 진행되던 당시, 한동안 궁기방 등과 함께 어울려 다니던 곤륜운룡(崑崙雲龍) 학우가 바로 청허자의 제자이기도 했으니.

summary: Several scene facts and relationships are altered, chiefly the sect’s lost headquarters, the old man’s movement through the air, and Hak Woo’s association with Gung Gibang.
